nodes.name: pnpm_migrate.sh
nodes.summary: Idempotent one-shot script migrating a developer checkout from npm to pnpm: checks Node against .nvmrc, activates pinned pnpm via corepack, removes npm artifacts, installs from the lockfile, regenerates the OSS tsconfig, and smoke-builds leaf packages.

nodes.name: sonar-project.properties
nodes.summary: SonarCloud project configuration for Packmind OSS defining organization/project keys, analyzed sources, and exclusions for build output, tests, playground, scripts, and agent skill folders.

nodes.name: standard-template.json
nodes.summary: JSON template for authoring a Packmind standard with name, description, scope, and a list of rule contents.

nodes.name: tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript base configuration for the Nx monorepo enabling strict mode and mapping every @packmind/* package alias to its source entry point.

nodes.name: tsconfig.paths.oss.json
nodes.summary: OSS-edition path overrides that redirect proprietary-only package aliases (linter, amplitude, plugins, spaces-management, marketplaces, etc.) to the packages/editions stub entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Edition switching is done purely through tsconfig path aliasing: the same import resolves to real code or a stub depending on which paths file is merged.

nodes.name: tsconfig.paths.proprietary.json
nodes.summary: Proprietary-edition path overrides mapping analytics, jobs, linter, amplitude, plugins, marketplaces and other enterprise package aliases to their real source entry points.
